problems.reason: Sentences 10, 11, and 12 give conflicting tribal assignments for Platypelta, stating it belongs to Ankylosaurini in 10 but to Euoplocephalini in 11 and 12.

notes: - contradiction: "Platypelta is classified within the family Ankylosauridae, subfamily Ankylosaurinae, and tribe Ankylosaurini." / "The parent group of Platypelta is the tribe Euoplocephalini." / "Platypelta is a member of the clade Euoplocephalini, which Penkalski established as an approximate synonym of Ankylosaurini.": Sentences 10, 11, and 12 give conflicting tribal assignments for Platypelta, stating it belongs to Ankylosaurini in 10 but to Euoplocephalini in 11 and 12.
